source: 662 Those Words
target: 662 Illa verba

source: Kolobo finally turned around.
target: Kolobo demum se conversus est.

source: He took off his sunglasses and spoke in Dutanese with a weary look,
target: Subtraxit oculos solares et Dutanice, vultu fesso, locutus est,

source: “My gut tells me I shouldn’t look directly at them.”
target: “Venter meus mihi monet, ne eos directe intuear.”

source: “I can only take a quick glance at most.”
target: “Solum brevem intuentiam accipere possum.”

source: “Why’s that?” Rhea asked curiously, her wildness evident as she carried her hunting bow.
target: “Cur ita?” Rhea curiose rogavit, cum ferocitas eius manifesta esset, dum arcum venaticum portabat.

source: “Just intuition,” Kolobo replied firmly, unsure of the reason but convinced he shouldn’t stare.
target: Kolobo firmiter respondit, “Solum intuitio,” incertus de causa, sed persuasus se non directe intueri debere.

source: Loban, the Feysacian, wore a pensive expression.
target: Loban, Feysacianus, vultum meditabundum gerebat.

source: “What’s on your mind?” Maslow, his face painted white, turned to him and asked.
target: “Quid in animo tuo est?” Maslow, cuius facies albo picta erat, ad eum conversus rogavit.

source: The three had worked together in Tizamo Town for a year and understood each other well.
target: Tres per annum in oppido Tizamo simul laboraverunt et se invicem bene intellexerunt.

source: Maslow could tell Loban had thought of something from his look.
target: Maslow ex vultu Loban aliquid cogitaverat animadvertit.

source: Observing Camus and the others’ gazes, Loban pondered for a moment before saying,
target: Observans oculos Camus aliorumque, Loban paulisper meditatus est, deinde dixit:

source: “While adventuring across the Five Seas, I came across this saying: ‘Don’t look directly at God.'”
target: “Dum per Quinque Maria peregrinabar, hoc proverbium inveni: ‘Noli directe Deum intueri.’”

source: “Don’t look directly at God…” Camus’s forehead twitched as he whispered the phrase.
target: “Noli directe Deum intueri…” frons Camus tremuit, dum verba sibilavit.

source: As a Castiya family descendant, albeit from a collateral branch, he had more extensive mystical knowledge than most Beyonders.
target: Ut descendentem familiae Castiyae, quamquam ex ramo collaterali, habebat scientiam mysticam amplior quam pluribus Beyonders.

source: Could it be that Louis Berry and his godson were actual gods, unable to be gazed upon?
target: Num fieri posset ut Ludovicus Berry et filius dei eius vere dei essent, quos directe intueri non possent?

source: No, that couldn’t be right.
target: Minime, id non potuit esse rectum.

source: Kolobo avoided looking at Twanaku directly, yet Twanaku was merely a Sequence 5 Beyonder of the Prisoner and Criminal pathways—not even a demigod!
target: Kolobo directe Twanaku intueri vitavit, sed Twanaku solum erat Beyonder Sequentionis V, in viis Captivi et Criminis—nec quidem semideus!

source: “I’ve heard that before during the padre’s sermons.”
target: Id antea audiveram in sermonibus sacerdotis.

source: “It’s about respecting and worshiping God, right?” said Rhea, a devout Eternal Blazing Sun believer.
target: “Agitur de Deum colendo et venerando, nonne?” inquit Rhea, devota fide Aeternae Solis Ardoris.

source: “No, it’s not from the Church scriptures. It’s recorded in a mystical text,” Loban shook his head, rejecting her explanation.
target: “Non, non est ex scripturis Ecclesiae. In textu mystico conscriptum est,” Loban caput submovit, explicationem eius reiecerat.

source: Maslow let out a deep chuckle.
target: Maslow risum gravem effudit.

source: “Surely the great adventurer can’t literally be a deity walking among us?”
target: “Certe, magnus adventor non potest vere esse deus ambulans inter nos?”

source: “Maybe not a true deity,” Loban recalled,
target: “Forsitan non verus deus,” Loban rememoravit,

source: “But the book’s notes state it refers to a ‘Mythical Creature’.
target: Sed notae libri indicant id ad “Creaturam Mythicam” referre.

source: “I’m unsure what exactly that means, but if it contains the word ‘god’, it must have at least some level of godhood.
target: Nescio quid id exacte significet, sed si verbum “deus” continet, saltem aliquo gradu divinitatis habere debet.

source: Could that adventurer be a demigod?”
target: Num ille adventor semideus esse possit?

source: “It doesn’t seem that way currently,” Camus said, gradually forming a new idea.
target: “Nondum ita videtur,” inquit Camus, novam cogitationem paulatim formans.

source: “Perhaps the adventurer is simply one of a deity’s Blessed, carrying a divine item or aura bestowed upon him.
target: “Forsitan adventor simpliciter unum ex benedictis dei sit, portans rem divinam aut auram ei concessam.

source: So it’s true we can’t directly look at ‘God’, but that ‘God’ isn’t referring to him, only something he possesses.”
target: Ita verum est: nos “Deum” directe intueri non possumus, sed ille “Deus” non ad se, sed ad rem quam habet, refertur.

source: This could explain the situation with Twanaku very well.
target: Hoc casum cum Twanaku optime explicare potest.

source: “You mean like the most famous adventurer?” Loban the Feysacian realized.
target: “Visne dicere sicut clarissimus adventor?” Loban Feysacianus intellexit.

source: Adventurers, treasure hunters, pirates and merchants across the Five Seas now knew Gehrman Sparrow had been The Fool’s Oracle before becoming an Angel.
target: Adventores, thesaurarii, piratae et mercatores per Quinque Maria iam noverunt Ludovicum Sparrow Oraculum Stulti fuisse, antequam Angelus factus esset.

source: “Precisely.” Camus nodded.
target: “Prorsus.” Camus annuit.

source: Simultaneously, he inwardly cursed.
target: Simul, intime maledixit.

source: Dogsh*t, why was I sent to watch over matters involving a deity’s Blessed?
target: “Canis stercus, cur missus sum ad inspiciendum res de benedictis dei?”

source: This was undoubtedly perilous.
target: Hoc indubitanter periculosum erat.

source: A moment of carelessness could lead to death!
target: Unum momentum negligentiae ad mortem ducere poterat!

source: Camus hadn’t wanted to accept Vice-Captain Reaza’s order the day before, but over the past five years, Reaza had saved him from the brink of death three times.
target: Camus heri iussum vice‐captain Reaza non suscipere voluit, sed per quinque annos praeteritos, Reaza eum a limine mortis ter servaverat.

source: He couldn’t refuse.
target: Non potuit recusare.

source: Otherwise, with the prestigious “Don” prefix and Castiya family name, he could have declined his superior’s orders.
target: Alioquin, cum insigni praefixo “Don” et familiae Castiyae nomine, ordines superioris recusare potuisset.

source: At worst, he could leave the patrol team and seek opportunities elsewhere.
target: In pessimo casu, turmam vigiliarum deserere et alibi occasiones quaerere potuisset.

source: After all, he had already digested the Sequence 7 Interrogator potion.
target: Postremo, potionem Interrogatoris Sequentionis VII iam consumpsit.

source: He had saved enough funds for his subsequent advancement thanks to Louis Berry’s two commissions.
target: Satis pecuniae servaverat ad ulterioris promotionis sui comparationem, gratia duarum commissionum a Ludovico Berry.

source: Even returning to his family, he wouldn’t be the type brushed aside.
target: Etiam, cum ad familiam rediret, non esset ille genus, qui facile reici possit.

source: But to repay Reaza’s kindness, Camus reluctantly agreed to come to Tizamo Town and monitor Louis Berry’s every move.
target: At, ut Reazae beneficium reddat, Camus, invito animo, consentiens ad oppidum Tizamo venire et omnes motūs Ludovici Berry observare, accessit.

source: Feeling upset, he couldn’t help but inwardly curse.
target: Tristitia affectus, intus maledixit.

source: As a devout and educated believer in Mother Earth, Camus wouldn’t curse with vulgar phrases like “son of a…”
target: Ut devotus et eruditus credens in Mater Terra, Camus verba obscena, ut “filius…”, non proferre solebat.

source: From his view, mothers were great—birth and nurturing equally important, just as the earth nurtured all things’ growth.
target: Eius autem iudicio, matres erant praeclarae—natalitas et alitio aeque magni momenti, sicut terra omnium rerum incrementum fovebat.

source: After discussing the adventurer Louis Berry, Loban the Feysacian turned to Camus and Kolobo, saying,
target: Postquam de adventore Ludovico Berry locutus erat, Loban Feysacianus ad Camum et Kolobo se convertit, dicens:

source: “When we transferred to Tizamo, we were told we could return after a year, that we wouldn’t stay forever.”
target: “Cum ad oppidum Tizamo translati essemus, dictum est nobis post annum redire posse, ne in perpetuum mansuri simus.”

source: “Now, nearly a year has passed, and you’re here too.”
target: “Iam, fere annum transitum est, et etiam tu hic es.”

source: “Does that mean we can return to Port Pylos?”
target: “Num hoc significat nos ad Portum Pylos redire posse?”

source: As a Feysacian, you appear tall, robust, boorish, and unintelligent, but you’re actually dishonest…
target: Ut Feysacianus, altus, robustus, rusticus, et ineptus videaris, sed re vera mendax es…

source: Did you discover that Louis Berry’s matter might be a huge problem and want an excuse to slip away early?
target: Animadvertistine rem Ludovici Berry posse esse ingentem quaestionem et quaerebas causam ut ante tempus evades?

source: Camus acutely sensed Loban’s hidden thoughts and joked, “There’s still a week left!”
target: Camus subtiliter animadvertit cogitationes latentes Loban et iocose dixit, “Adhuc septimana manet!”

source: “Don’t even think about returning to Port Pylos early. We’re not here for your rotation.”
target: “Ne quidem cogita redire ad Portum Pylos ante tempus. Non ad tuam vicem hic sumus.”

source: At the Brieu Motel.
target: Apud Brieu Motel.

source: This was the favorite accommodation for the gentlemen who came to Tizamo Town to hunt.
target: Hoc erat praelatum hospitium virorum, qui ad oppidum Tizamo venabant ut venarentur.

source: Although it couldn’t compare to Hotel Orella, it was at least relatively clean.
target: Quamquam cum Hotel Orella comparari non poterat, saltem admodum mundum erat.

source: Lumian’s sole reason for choosing this place was the availability of a suite.
target: Unica causa quam Lumian eligere hunc locum fuit, quia suite praesto erat.

source: Otherwise, he would have to rent two adjacent rooms and utilize his Hunter’s precise grasp of structures to blast through the adjoining wall without affecting the overall load‐bearing walls.
target: Alioquin duas cellas contiguas conducere debebat et, arte venatoris subtili structurarum perspiciente, parietem iunctum disrumpere sine laedendo reliquos muros portantes, conari debebat.

source: When departing, he’d get Lugano to replace the stone bricks and repair the opening.
target: Cum discederet, petiebatur a Lugano ut lateres lapideos substitueret et aperturam repararet.

source: The ground floor was equally open, supported by stone pillars.
target: Piso terreno aeque apertum erat, columnis lapideis sustentatum.

source: However, the three‐story building above bore a distinct Intisian flair.
target: Attamen, aedificium tribus tabulatis superius indolem Intisianam ostendebat.

source: The beige walls, recessed statuary niches, arched windows, and Venetian curtains made Lumian feel as if he had returned to Trier.
target: Muri lutei, niche statuarum receptae, fenestrae arcuatae, et cortinae Venetiarum, Lumian efficiebant ut se quasi ad Treveros rediisset.

source: When Lugano lit the mosquito repellent candle and used its slightly pungent smell to chase away the poisonous insects and mosquitoes, it became even more reminiscent.
target: Cum Lugano candelam culicibus repellendam accendit et eius leviter pungentem odorem ad insecta venenata et culices fugandos usus est, rem adhuc magis memorabilem reddidit.

source: This is very similar to Trieriens using sulfur’s smell to repel bedbugs… Lumian recalled his initial arrival in Trier.
target: Hoc valde simile est Trierens, qui sulfuris odorem ad cimicos repellendos utebantur… Lumian primum adventum suum in Treveris meminit.

source: After using sulfur’s smell to chase the bedbugs into the neighboring room, playwright Gabriel ignited it and drove them back.
target: Postquam odor sulfuris cimicos in cellam proximam fugare conatus est, scriptor Gabriel eam incendit et eos repulit.

source: After this back-and-forth, most bedbugs went elsewhere, leaving only a few that the doll messenger eliminated.
target: Post hoc fluctuationem, plerique cimices alibi dispersae sunt, relinquentes paucos quos nuntius pupulae delevit.

source: Lumian sighed silently, recalling Gabriel’s death and the deceased tenants of the Auberge du Coq Doré.
target: Lumian silentio suspiravit, memor Gabrielis mortis et defunctorum incolarum Auberge du Coq Doré.

source: He walked to the window and gazed at the street below.
target: Ad fenestram processit et viam deorsum contemplatus est.

source: The gentlemen in hunting attire and their servants on unicorns weaved through the dark-brown or light-brown townspeople, flowing into Brieu Motel, jungle restaurants, and other establishments like rivers.
target: Viri in veste venatoria et servi eorum, in unicornibus, per cives fuscos aut pallidos transibant, fluentia in Brieu Motel, cauponas in silva, et alias institutiones ut flumina.

source: Under the noon sun, Tizamo Town was scorchingly humid this season, making it unsuitable for outdoor activities.
target: Sub sole meridiano, oppidum Tizamo non parvum erat, cum viis in duas partes distributas habens; hoc tempore ardenter humidum erat quod id in res extra aedificia agenda inhabilitabat.

source: On the second floor, Lumian focused his attention and observed the passersby directly below.
target: In secundo piano, Lumian animadvertit et transientes viatores directim perspiciens observavit.

source: He attempted to discern any potential issues with Tizamo Town from their fortunes.
target: Conatus est ex eorum fortunis quaedam problemata in Tizamo oppido discernere.

source: He was prepared for backlash or corruption.
target: Paratus erat ad repulsionem aut corruptionem.

source: These passersby’s fortunes are normal.
target: Fortuna horum transitorum ordinaria est.

source: Some seem to have romantic encounters looming, some would lose money, and some might encounter a bloody calamity, but nothing too serious…
target: Quidam videntur amatorias congressiones imminere, quidam pecuniam amittere, aliique calamitatem sanguinolentam pati, sed nihil nimis grave…

source: Lumian averted his gaze and said to Lugano, “Take Ludwig to rest. I’ll take a walk outside.”
target: Lumian oculos avertit et Lugano inquit, “Ludwigum ad quietem ducas. Ego foris ambulabo.”

source: “Alright.” Knowing the trip to Tizamo Town might be dangerous, Lugano had no intention of wandering out unless his boss asked him to prepare food for Ludwig.
target: “Recte.” Sciens iter ad oppidum Tizamo esse periculosum, Lugano non intendebat foras vagari, nisi eius praefectus petierit ut cibum Ludwigi praepararet.

source: He had no choice but to go along. Otherwise, he would be the one eaten!
target: Non habuit aliam optionem quam se adiungere; aliter ipse edendus esset!

source: Tizamo Town wasn’t small with streets spanning out in two directions.
target: Oppidum Tizamo non erat parvum, cum viis in duas partes distributas habens.

source: Lumian strolled leisurely, hands in pockets, donning a golden straw hat.
target: Lumian lente ambulabat, manibus in sinu, pileum stramineum aureum gerens.

source: He no longer wore the straw hat to enhance Louis Berry’s persona, but to shield himself from the sunlight.
target: Iamdudum non pileum stramineum gerebat ad imaginem Ludovici Berry excitandam, sed ut se a sole defendat.

source: He had intended to do so many times before.
target: Id ante multoties facere intendebat.

source: This was because an adverse effect of Shadow Transformation was a greater fear of sunlight than ordinary people.
target: Hoc erat, quod effectus adversus Transformationem Umbrae metum solis maiorem parabat quam in hominibus vulgaribus.

source: Although Lumian could endure relying on his Ascetic abilities, this would impact his condition to some extent.
target: Quamquam Lumian virtutibus suis asceticis patientiam ostendere posset, hoc aliquam partem condicionis eius afficere debebat.

source: Why make things difficult when he could resolve it with a straw hat?
target: Cur res difficiles facere, cum ea pileo stramineo solvi possit?

source: Moreover, with the appearance of Louis Berry wearing a golden straw hat, the enemy wouldn’t think he was afraid of sunlight.
target: Praeterea, cum Ludovicus Berry pileum stramineum aureum gerendo appareret, hostis non existimaret eum solis metuere.

source: As his gaze casually shifted, Lumian spotted a girl.
target: Cum aspectus eius leve volubriter mutatus esset, Lumian puellam aspexit.

source: She was a typical Northern Continent native, her black hair cascading down her back like a waterfall, a few sparkling bows adorning her head.
target: Ea erat genuina indigena Septentrionalis Continenti; capilli eius nigri, quasi cataracta in tergo decurrentes, et paucis nodis micantibus caput ornabant.

source: Her azure-tinged eyes accentuated her sharp, delicate nose.
target: Oculi eius, caeruleo tincti, nasum acutum et tenerum illustrabant.

source: An unmistakable youthful aura radiated between her brows.
target: Indubitus aura iuvenilis inter supercilia eius radiebatur.

source: The girl wore a light, lace-trimmed, pleated white dress, but instead of high heels, she donned a pair of brown leather boots.
target: Puella vestem albam levem, plicatam et lacis ornatam gerebat, sed pro calceamentis altis, calceos ex coriaceo fusco induit.

source: As she conversed and laughed with companions, she danced, seemingly unconcerned about passersby’s opinions.
target: Dum cum comitibus colloquebatur et ridebat, saltabat, quasi de sententiis transeuntium nihil curans.

source: Lumian glanced at her again.
target: Lumian eam rursus aspexit.

source: It wasn’t because she was beautiful.
target: Non propterea quod pulchra esset.

source: Although quite lovely, her appearance and bearing couldn’t compare to a Demoness or truly beautiful humans.
target: Etsi decora esset, species et habitus eius non adaequare poterant daemonis aut verorum pulchrorum hominum.

source: Lumian simply sensed her personality differed from Trier’s ladies.
target: Lumian facile sensit indolem eius ab mulieribus Treveris differri.

source: In Trier, no matter how open-minded respectable middle and upper-class women were in private, they still publicly cared about image and others’ opinions—a product of their upbringing.
target: In Treveris, quamquam feminae honorabiles mediæ et superioris ordinis in privato mente aperta erant, publice tamen de imagine et aliis opinionibus solliciti erant—effectus educationis eōrum.

source: This girl exuded an air of freedom.
target: Haec puella aerem libertatis efferebat.

source: She could laugh loudly or spin around whenever she pleased.
target: Poterat alte ridere aut se circa vertere, quotiens vellebat.

source: This was distinct from an improperly raised lower-class woman’s demeanor.
target: Hoc discrevit ab indolis feminae classis inferioris male educatae.

source: This girl’s attire, speech and aura indicated good education and upbringing.
target: Ornatus, sermo et aura huius puellae demonstrabant bonam eruditionem atque institutionem.

source: “Amandina, daughter of Palms Manor’s Sir Petit, and Monsieur Robert’s fiancée,” Camus, resembling a specter, materialized from nowhere beside Lumian with the introduction.
target: “Amandina, filia Palms Manor Domini Petit, et sponsa Domini Robert,” inquit Camus, quasi phantasma, ex nihilo iuxta Lumian apparuit.

source: Palms Manor was a plantation near Tizamo Town.
target: Palms Manor erat plantatio prope oppidum Tizamo.

source: A Southern Continent girl raised without Trier’s upper‑middle‑class societal constraints…
target: Puella Australis Continenti, sine vinculis societatis feminarum Treverenses superior-mediæ educata…

source: As Lumian judged this, he thought of his sister Aurore.
target: Cum id iudicaverit, de sorore sua Aurore meminisse coepit.

source: Sometimes, Aurore displayed such a side.
target: Aliquando, Aurore talem faciem exhibebat.

source: However, the reasons were clearly different.
target: Attamen causae clarissime diversa erant.

source: “Where are you headed?” Camus inquired.
target: “Quo vadis?” inquit Camus.

source: Lumian retracted his gaze and replied with a smile, “The cathedral.
target: Lumian oculos avertit et cum risu respondit, “Ecclesia cathedralis.”

source: “Are you coming with me to praise the Sun?”
target: “Venisne mecum ad Solem laudandum?”
